focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期临近，中国出口企业需紧急核查CBAM申报数据
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征收阶段。近期欧委会强化了对进口商季度报告的核查，中国钢铁、铝、化肥等行业出口企业如未准确申报隐含碳排放，将面临罚款及未来碳成本转嫁风险。建议企业立即梳理对欧出口产品清单，收集实际排放数据，并与欧盟进口商确认申报责任分配，必要时引入第三方核查机构。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.09.17
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Verify Emissions Data
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period ends in late 2026, with definitive levies starting in 2027. The European Commission has recently intensified scrutiny of importers' quarterly reports. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, and fertilisers that fail to accurately declare embedded emissions risk penalties and future carbon cost pass-through. Companies should immediately map EU-bound products, collect actual emissions data, and clarify reporting responsibilities with EU importers, engaging third-party verifiers where necessary.

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭确立跨境数据泄露管辖新标准，中资企业需关注域外效力
case.summary: 新加坡上诉法院近期在首例跨境数据泄露集体诉讼中裁定，只要受影响个人在新加坡境内，即使数据存储于境外服务器，新加坡《个人数据保护法》仍可适用。该判决对在东南亚运营的中资企业具有警示意义：需重新评估数据本地化策略与跨境传输协议，确保符合新加坡及周边国家的数据保护要求，并完善泄露应急响应机制，以降低域外管辖风险。
case.source: 来源：新加坡上诉法院 · 2026年9月
case.title_en: Singapore Appellate Court Sets New Jurisdictional Standard for Cross-Border Data Breaches
case.summary_en: Singapore's Court of Appeal recently ruled in a landmark cross-border data breach class action that the Personal Data Protection Act can apply as long as affected individuals are in Singapore, even if data is stored on overseas servers. This decision serves as a warning for Chinese companies operating in Southeast Asia: they must reassess data localisation strategies and cross-border transfer agreements, ensure compliance with Singapore and neighbouring jurisdictions' data protection rules, and strengthen breach response mechanisms to mitigate extraterritorial jurisdiction risks.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore Court of Appeal · September 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境商事纠纷“一站式”解决平台，助力企业高效解纷
policy.summary: 广东省司法厅与香港律政司、澳门法务局近期联合推出粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线解纷平台，整合调解、仲裁与诉讼服务，支持三地法律规则衔接。企业可通过平台在线申请调解、选择仲裁机构或对接法院，实现跨境纠纷“一网通办”。该举措有助于降低出海企业维权成本，提升大湾区法治化营商环境，建议企业法务部门提前熟悉平台操作流程。
policy.source: 来源：广东省司法厅 · 2026年9月
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches One-Stop Cross-Border Commercial Dispute Resolution Platform
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice, Hong Kong Department of Justice, and Macao Legal Affairs Bureau have jointly launched a one-stop online dispute resolution platform for cross-border commercial disputes in the Greater Bay Area. The platform integrates mediation, arbitration, and litigation services, supporting alignment of legal rules across the three jurisdictions. Companies can file for mediation, select arbitral institutions, or connect with courts online, enabling end-to-end handling of cross-border disputes. This initiative reduces enforcement costs for outbound firms and enhances the GBA's rule-of-law business environment. Legal teams are advised to familiarise themselves with the platform's procedures in advance.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice · September 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华投资限制新规扩围，企业需重构跨境交易合规架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期进一步扩大对华投资限制范围，将更多敏感技术领域纳入申报与禁止交易清单。中国出海企业及其美元基金投资人在进行跨境并购、合资或技术授权时，应提前开展交易对方及标的的筛查，识别是否涉及受限技术或“美国人”参与，必要时调整交易架构，如剥离敏感资产或引入非美资方。同时，建议在合同中加入合规陈述保证与分手费条款，以应对监管审批不确定性。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 编辑室 · 2026.09.17
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: New US Outbound Investment Rules Expand Scope—Firms Must Restructure Cross-Border Compliance
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US has further expanded its outbound investment restrictions on China, adding more sensitive technology sectors to the notification and prohibited transaction lists. Chinese outbound companies and their USD fund investors engaging in cross-border M&A, joint ventures, or technology licensing should conduct early screening of counterparties and targets to identify involvement of restricted technologies or 'US persons'. Where necessary, they should adjust deal structures, such as divesting sensitive assets or bringing in non-US investors. It is also advisable to include compliance representations, warranties, and break fees in contracts to address regulatory approval uncertainties.
